args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail (e.g. 2.665 rounds to
2.67 instead of 2.66). Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match FIN-212.

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py::round_money` claimed banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This made the nightly build fail in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
- Switched the `quantize` rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed (including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`).

Please approve so this can merge and ship in today's release.
